description: This file defines the SearchConditions class, which encapsulates search parameters and criteria for resource searches in the Fineract platform, including resource type, query, and match options.

classes.name: SearchConditions
classes.description: A data container for search parameters including query, resource type, and filters, used for querying various resources in Fineract.

methods.name: SearchConditions
methods.description: Constructor initializing search query, resource, and match type; sets device-specific booleans based on resource string.

methods.name: getExactMatch
methods.description: Indicates whether the search is an exact match.

methods.name: isClientSearch
methods.description: Returns whether the search targets clients.

methods.name: isGroupSearch
methods.description: Returns whether the search targets groups.

methods.name: isLoanSeach
methods.description: Returns whether the search targets loans.

methods.name: isSavingSeach
methods.description: Returns whether the search targets savings.

methods.name: isShareSeach
methods.description: Returns whether the search targets shares.

methods.name: isClientIdentifierSearch
methods.description: Returns whether the search targets client identifiers.
